# Notix

> Notix is an AI note taker for iPhone. It records lectures, meetings and interviews, transcribes them, and writes structured summaries — and does the same with uploaded documents, YouTube videos, web articles and social posts. Any summary can be turned into quizzes and flashcards. Free to start; Notix Pro removes the limits on recording hours, quiz questions, and PDF and video summarisation.

Facts an agent can rely on (all mirrored on the pages below):

- Platform: iPhone. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758561284
- Inputs: live recording, audio file upload, documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, RTF, CSV, XLS, XLSX), YouTube links, web articles, and posts from TikTok, Instagram, X and Reddit.
- Outputs: transcript, structured summary, quizzes, flashcards, AI chat with answers linked to their source, PDF export.
- YouTube summaries are built from the video's captions; a video with captions disabled cannot be summarised.
- Sign-in: Google, Apple, or email and password.
- Transcription and summarisation run on Notix servers, so they need a connection. Content already generated is cached on the device and readable offline.
- An uploaded document is deleted from Notix servers once it has been processed; the transcript and summary remain.
- A deleted note leaves the library immediately and is erased permanently after 30 days.
- User content is not used to train AI models and is not sold.
- Account deletion is available in-app (Settings → Account details → Delete account) with a 30-day grace period.
- Billing is handled by Apple; subscriptions are managed in iOS Settings → Subscriptions. A monthly plan carries a 3-day free trial, an annual plan a 7-day free trial.
- App interface languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Polish. Transcription and summaries are not limited to those six.
- Support contact: support@notix-ai.app

## Core pages

- [Home](https://notix-ai.app/): product overview, how it works, features, FAQ
- [Examples](https://notix-ai.app/examples/): real Notix output from openly licensed lectures, papers and articles — transcript excerpt, summary, flashcards and quiz, published unedited, each with its source, licence and processing date
- [Support](https://notix-ai.app/support/): contact, bug reports, billing and refunds, account deletion, rules on recording
- [Privacy Policy](https://notix-ai.app/privacy/): what data is collected, AI processing, retention, user rights

## Languages

The home page and the support page are published in 23 languages. English lives at the
root; every other language sits under its own prefix, and each page declares the full
set through hreflang.

Examples and the privacy policy are published in English only.
